description: Biz, NASA’nın Ay ve Mars görevlerinde kullanılan ve görevleri bittikten sonra geride bırakılan ekipmanların hikayelerini anlatmayı amaçlayan bir takımız. Bu araçları uzay tarihinin sessiz tanıkları olarak görüyor, geçmiş görevlerini ve insanlığa katkılarını yaratıcı hikâyelerle yeniden canlandırıyoruz. Takımımız; grafik tasarımı, yazma gibi becerilerini de ekleyerek harika bir takım çalışması oluşturuyor.
summary: The vehicle, which was produced in 2026 and sent to examine the moon much more closely, goes out of orbit and falls to the surface of Mars, in fact, this inspires scientists and they produce hundreds of this vehicle, send one of them to Mars and use it to get back the vehicle left on Mars. After being rescued in this vehicle years later, he feels valuable and comes back to the world.
details:
We started from the story of the rescue of a robot waiting to be discovered on Mars in 2078. Our project is a work that visualizes and narrates how vehicles lost in deep space can be restored with new generation autonomous systems.

We made the project unique by combining technological development between old and new generation robots with a human narrative, not only by making technical modelling. In our study, we used various visualisation tools for mechanical and space environment designs. Based on Mars's challenging terrain conditions and the technological leap over time, we've come up with a concept that is both emotionally and technically consistent.
